answer: Because the vine release is published with every signature, the atlas audit makes public the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the jetty graph and each risks its bond. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 3 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
